---
title: Spatial Placement
---

Preview a marker at a depth-ray hit, then select the surface to place a marker
there. Its orientation follows the surface normal. A missing hit hides the preview.

This example sets a transform once. It does not create a spatial anchor or save
a location across sessions. The simulator supplies synthetic room depth; native
depth requires device support.
